title: fix(deps)!: hono ^4.13.16 and @hono/node-server ^2.1.6 clear seven public advisories; a request path holding a backslash is answered 400
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33211

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `@hono/node-server` 2.1.6 answers `400 Bad Request` to a request whose path (the part before `?`) holds a backslash, before any route runs; up to 2.1.5 the backslash was rewritten to `/` and the request reached the route that path names. No other status, header, body or error text of ours moves, and the request-body limit (`413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`) answers as before.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` and no page under `content/docs/**` teaches request-path spelling at the HTTP door.

> ⚠️ **Owes a contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (narrowing) from the new review agent.** Seat contract reviews are paused until that agent is online (maintainer instruction, 2026-11-14 04:37Z), so this draft is not landed before that review is on record.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 HTTP 底座 `hono` 升到 `^4.13.16`、`@hono/node-server` 升到 `^2.1.6`（锁文件实际落在 4.13.18 / 2.1.8），工作区里这两条 override 的目标同步抬高，7 个包的声明版本一起改，下游安装也会拿到修复版。
- 为什么改：每天的依赖安全扫描在 main 上是红的，18.4.0 带着 7 条公开漏洞（6 中 1 低），每个部署的 HTTP 栈都在用这两个包；修复版已发布，不加豁免。
- 风险与回滚：patch 级。唯一会变的回答：URL 路径里带反斜杠（如 `/api/v1\health`）的请求，现在直接回 400，以前会被改成 `/` 继续路由；浏览器和常见 HTTP 库本来就不会发这种请求。请求体上限的 413 不受影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的两条 override 和注释；`.changeset/33211-hono-security-bump.md`（BREAKING 说明）；`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/request-target-backslash.pin.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server exec vitest run src/request-target-backslash.pin.test.ts`，预期 3/3 通过（带反斜杠 400，不带 200，`?` 后的反斜杠 200）。
- 需要你做的：无，等新的评审 agent 做完契约复审后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **Pins.** `hono` `^4.13.9` → `^4.13.16` in `plugin-hono-server` and `plugin-auth` (dependencies) and in `@objectstack/hono`, `trigger-api`, `plugin-webhooks`, `plugin-approvals` (devDependencies). `@hono/node-server` `^2.1.3` → `^2.1.6` in `plugin-hono-server` (dependency) and `client` (devDependency). The `@objectstack/hono` **peer** range on `hono` stays `^4.12.8`, as the workspace note records.
- **Overrides.** `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `'hono@<5.0.0'` target `^4.13.5` → `^4.13.16`, `'@hono/node-server@<3.0.0'` target `^2.1.3` → `^2.1.6`, selectors unchanged at the major boundary, one dated note line each. The overrides rewrite every in-scope specifier, so the declarations alone would not move the lock (precedent #16999, #27921; seat claim amendment 6871660942).
- **Lock.** Regenerated with the pinned pnpm 10.31.0 (`pnpm install`). Only hono and node-server keys move: `hono@4.13.12` → `4.13.18`, `@hono/node-server@2.1.5(hono@4.13.12)` → `2.1.8(hono@4.13.18)`, the two override lines and the in-scope specifiers (56 lines, 28 +/28 −). The caret targets float to the newest patch, as #6095 measured for this override shape; that is also what a downstream install of `^4.13.16` / `^2.1.6` resolves today.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/33211-hono-security-bump.md`, patch for the seven packages, BREAKING banner for the backslash-path 400, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- **Pin.** `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/request-target-backslash.pin.test.ts` (asked by the seat): over a real listener and a raw socket (`fetch` normalises the backslash client-side), `/api/v1/things\t_1` answers 400, `/api/v1/things/t_1` answers 200, and `/api/v1/things/t_1?q=a\b` answers 200.

## Acceptance notes

- **OSV.** The scheduled run 43549452164 lists exactly the seven rows. `api.osv.dev` is refused by this container's proxy, so the scan itself is not run locally: NOT MEASURED locally, read from this PR's `Validate Dependencies` run. After the bump `pnpm-lock.yaml` holds only `hono@4.13.18` and `@hono/node-server@2.1.8`, both at or above every advisory's fixed version. `osv-scanner.toml` is unchanged (no new exemption).
- **Upstream changes read (npm tarball diffs, 4.13.12 → 4.13.18, 2.1.5 → 2.1.8).** Body reading is untouched: `hono/utils/body` and node-server's request-body path did not change, so #33172's request-body limit answers as before (pins and dogfood below). Changes that do not move an answer of ours: node-server websocket-upgrade target checks (we run no node-server upgrade), response-stream cancel on a destroyed socket, hono RegExpRouter wildcard/middleware matching rewrite and `getPath` handling of a malformed `%` (the suites below stay green, no route of ours moved), query-key lookup for crafted queries, and csrf / validator / hono serve-static / `.mount()` / cookie / accepts changes in middlewares we do not import.
- **Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) on the touched surface: hits only in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s better-auth and scim notes, which do not govern the hono lines. No hits in the touched `package.json` files.
- **Serial.** No open PR touches the hono pins, the two override lines or the lock's hono entries (checked before push).

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation of the backslash pin (node-server's refusal put back to 2.1.5's behaviour)</summary>

- Mutation: in the installed `@hono/node-server@2.1.8` `dist/index.mjs` (what `plugin-hono-server` resolves; no vitest alias), the line `if (query === -1 || backslash < query) throw new RequestError("Backslash in request path");` replaced by a comment. On disk: anchor count 0, marker count 1.
- Red: `1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. The backslash request was routed: `Received: "HTTP/1.1 200 OK ... {\"success\":true,\"data\":{\"id\":\"t_1\"}}"` at `request-target-backslash.pin.test.ts:53`.
- Restored by copy, sha256 compared equal (`1c062cab…`), re-run `3 passed (3)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood boot (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38421`, Console built with `pnpm console:build`)</summary>

- Page: `GET /` → 200 `text/html`, redirected to `/_console/`, title `ObjectOS`.
- Sign-in as the seeded dev admin → 200. API read: `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account?limit=2` → 200 with records.
- Oversized body: an 11 MiB JSON `POST /api/v1/data/crm_account/query` → `413` `"code":"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE"`; a small body on the same door → 200.
- Raw request lines: `GET /api/v1/health` → `200 OK`; `GET /api/v1\health` → `400 Bad Request`; `GET /api/v1/health?x=a\b` → `200 OK`.
- The server resolved `@hono/node-server@2.1.8_hono@4.13.18`. Server stopped afterwards.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates (derived at 76bc2487, 79 commands)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 79 commands; each run with stdin from `/dev/null`, exit codes recorded before any pipe: **79 × exit 0**.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `79 derived, 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero: every line carries an exit code, none is 3).
- A first gate pass ran while a declaration-less ui build was rewriting shared `dist/` (5 prerequisite/resolve reds: `check:skill-examples`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`). That pass was discarded, the closure rebuilt with declarations, and all 79 re-run green.
- Server-lane rule: `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) at `56fd8aeb` → exit 0.
- OSV scan: NOT MEASURED locally (`api.osv.dev` refused by the container proxy); this PR's `Validate Dependencies` run is the reading.

</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery at 56fd8aeb (owed by the narrowing arm)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, no shard, no path: `VERDICT command-exit 1` · `Test Files 1 failed | 465 passed | 1 skipped (467)` · `Tests 6 failed | 3932 passed | 31 skipped (3969)`.
- The one failing file is `test/print-service-render.dogfood.test.ts` (6 of 8: "The print page did not finish rendering within 30 s … the console never showed a print page for the record"). It runs only where a built Console and a Chromium are both present; CI's dogfood job builds no Console, so CI skips it. This container had both because the dogfood boot above built the Console.
- **Not this change:** the same file, alone, with the installed `hono` / `@hono/node-server` contents swapped back to main's 4.13.12 / 2.1.5 (copied from the npm tarballs, restored afterwards, tree hashes compared equal), fails the same 6 tests the same way (`6 failed | 2 passed (8)`). Noted for the seat, not filed by this card.

</details>
